name: Soul of Light is a native cooldown modifier on An'she's Blessing and a doubling modifier on Vow of Light (#3695)
contract: Spell.dbc 807964 ("Soul of Light", SpellFamilyName 33, Passive) effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (107) with EffectMiscValue 11 (SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN), EffectBasePoints -60001 (amount -60000 ms), and EffectSpellClassMask word 2 = 33554432, which a repository-wide Spell.dbc scan for family-33 spells shows matches exactly one spell: 804058 "An'she's Blessing". Effect 1 is SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (108) with EffectMiscValue 8 (SPELLMOD_ALL_EFFECTS), EffectBasePoints 99 (amount 100), and EffectSpellClassMask word 3 = 536870912, which the same scan shows matches exactly one spell: 807750 "Vow of Light" (SLS Inherit Aura). Player::ApplySpellMod (Player.cpp:10219): a single -60000 flat COOLDOWN modifier on base 0 reads back exactly -60000 (the tooltip's 'Reduces the cooldown of An'she's Blessing by 60 sec'); a single +100% ALL_EFFECTS pct modifier makes totalmul = 2.0, so base 1000 reads back 2000 (the tooltip's 'the value of Vow of Light is doubled'). This is a fully generic native pipeline; no server script exists or is needed.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
An'she's Blessing's cooldown is reduced by exactly 60 sec
Vow of Light's value is exactly doubled
An unrelated family-33 spell (An'she's Blessing) is not doubled
